name: Isaac Argens
original_name: イザーク・アージェンス
source:
A knight who belongs to no nation, intervening from time to time in the wars between the two countries.

Calm and composed, yet occasionally showing a playful, mischievous side. Their gender is unknown—and they themselves never reveal it.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
